messages:
maya: Quick sync — need to lock down scope for the Console telemetry deliverable for next sprint. Customers have three asks that keep coming: 1) a ‘cost by route’ dashboard (per-model / per-endpoint breakdown), 2) an error-rollup view with pinpoint links to failing traces, and 3) sampling controls for tracing hooks (psuedo-SLA-aware). I sketched a proposal below with what I think we can realistically ship in one sprint vs. what should be deferred.

maya: Proposal (MVP slice):
- Cost-by-route: aggregate token and request cost by route + top 10 heavy users, simple heatmap. Use existing billing stream (no schema changes).
- Error rollup: group by error class + first 5 examples, link into full span view (trace id anchor).
- Tracing hooks: default 0.5% sample, UI slider to bump to 5% for canaries only.

jon: quick q — is the cost-by-route agg doable without per-tenant enrichment in the ingest? last time that bit added 2 days of infra work.

sam: We can piggyback on token-level events that billing already emits. Need a small enrichment job to attribute route names; estimate 3 dev days + 1 infra day for rollout gating.

elaine: For error rollup — can we avoid reprocessing raw traces? maybe just index error metadata at capture time (status_code, exception, model_id, route). That's small and gives fast UI.

maya: Agree, elaine. Index at capture time. That reduces reprocessing risk and keeps cost predictable.

jon: If we index at capture, how do we keep trace links light? we can't store full spans. store trace_id + sample_flag + short message. UI can link to trace viewer service.

sam: yep — index: {trace_id, route, error_class, short_msg, timestamp} — small. Implementation note: need to add route to the trace capture header (already present on some customers but not guaranteed).

maya: Launch criteria I'm proposing:
- Feature parity: cost-widget shows route breakdown + export CSV
- Ops: rollout with canary (1 org) and automatic rollback if token-cost spike > 25%
- SLO: dashboard queries < 300ms for 95% of loads
- Privacy: Private deployment path must redact free-text error messages unless tenant allows

ops-bot: deploy-plan created: /deploys/console-telemetry/v1 — canary window 24h, alert on 20% traffic divergence.

elaine: tradeoffs: if we keep sample low we lose trace coverage for low-volume routes. Could add a 'debug' toggle per-route but that's more product polish.

jon: dev ask: can we defer per-tenant historical backfill? i'd rather ship incremental and avoid a heavy reindex. +1 to canary-only higher sampling.

maya: decision (tentative): ship MVP slice, index error metadata at capture, add route enrichment pipeline as small job, tracing slider in UI for canary orgs only. Defer per-tenant historical backfill and per-route debug toggles to backlog.

sam: ok — I'll file the infra tickets and tag eng-sre for rollout playbook.

maya: thanks — can everyone react with :thumbsup: if they approve this scope and i'll put it on the sprint board. If you have objections please drop them here before EOD.

jon: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

elaine: :thumbsup:
